documents.t: Azure Landing Zone provides a scalable and governed foundation for enterprise cloud adoption. The objective is to establish a secure, compliant and operationally manageable Azure environment before workloads are deployed. Landing Zone architecture standardizes governance, identity, networking, security, monitoring, cost management and operations across Azure subscriptions.
Azure Landing Zone은 업무 시스템을 Azure로 옮기기 전에 마련하는 클라우드 운영 기반입니다. 관리 그룹, 구독, 네트워크, 접근 권한과 보안 정책을 정하고 운영 담당자를 지정합니다. 이 기준에 맞춰 모니터링과 비용 관리를 설정하면 시스템을 추가할 때마다 운영 방식을 새로 정할 필요가 줄어듭니다.

Typical Azure initiatives include: Datacenter modernization Azure migration programs Hybrid cloud deployment Disaster recovery implementation Application modernization Azure Virtual Desktop deployment AI and data platform initiatives Global cloud expansion

Azure 랜딩 존 요소 5개 · 선택하면 역할과 연결을 보여 줍니다 테넌트 루트공유 플랫폼랜딩 존정책과 권한워크로드관리 그룹관리 그룹정책 상속배치테넌트 루트공유 플랫폼랜딩 존정책과 권한워크로드관리 그룹관리 그룹정책 상속배치 테넌트 루트 테넌트 루트는 관리 그룹 계층의 최상위입니다. 루트에 직접 할당하는 정책은 최소화하고, 공통 정책은 해당 구독을 묶는 관리 그룹에 할당하세요. 공유 플랫폼 ID, 네트워크 연결, 관리용 구독에서 여러 팀이 함께 쓰는 서비스를 운영합니다. 랜딩 존 운영·비운영·샌드박스 환경을 구독으로 나누고 각 구독의 책임자를 정합니다. 정책과 권한 Azure Policy, RBAC, 태그, 예산과 보안 모니터링의 적용 범위를 정하고 예외가 의도대로 작동하는지 시험합니다. 워크로드 준비한 환경에 애플리케이션, 데이터, AI와 통합 워크로드를 배치합니다.

Avoid duplicating the organization chart or creating management groups solely for production/test/development separation; use subscriptions where appropriate. Keep root assignments limited and scope workload-team RBAC to the subscriptions or resource groups they need. See current management group recommendations.

For new network logging, use virtual network flow logs. NSG flow logs no longer allow new creation and retire on September 30, 2027. Plan migration of existing logs and Traffic Analytics instead of copying a legacy NSG logging deployment. See the retirement and migration notice.

Decision Recommended Question Management group model Which hierarchy supports policy inheritance and business ownership? Subscription strategy How are production, non-production, sandbox and shared services separated? Network topology Is hub-and-spoke, virtual WAN or isolated workload design appropriate? Security baseline Which Defender, logging, key management and backup controls are mandatory? Policy enforcement Which Azure Policy rules should be audit-only first and enforced later? FinOps model How are budgets, tags, alerts and cost ownership managed?

Deploying production workloads before the Landing Zone is defined Using a flat subscription model for all workloads Treating Azure Policy as a one-time compliance task Allowing broad Owner permissions without PIM and review Building network connectivity without central inspection and logging Ignoring cost ownership until consumption has already grown

Azure Landing Zone target architecture Management group and subscription design Hub-and-spoke network architecture Azure Policy and tagging standard RBAC and PIM access model Security monitoring and logging design Backup and disaster recovery baseline FinOps dashboard and cost governance model

Function Owner Identity IAM Team Network Infrastructure Team Security Security Team Monitoring Operations Team Governance Cloud Center of Excellence Cost Management FinOps Team Workload Ownership Application or Business Service Owner

Define policy ownership and exceptions before deploying workloads. Document network dependencies and test affected traffic before changing the production topology. Review RBAC scope, privileged role activation and policy compliance during operations. Review costs by subscription and resource group; use consistent tags where supported to allocate shared costs. See Cost Analysis grouping options. Reuse the reviewed platform foundation for new workloads and measure onboarding time before claiming delivery improvements. Security architecture must be embedded into the foundation, not added later.

documents.t: This guide covers identity, data access and operating responsibilities for Microsoft 365 Copilot. Successful adoption requires a secure architecture that combines identity, permissions, information architecture, governance, compliance and change management. This reference architecture provides a framework for enterprise Copilot readiness and long-term AI adoption.

Copilot을 도입할 때는 사용자가 어떤 Microsoft 365 자료에 접근할 수 있는지 먼저 확인해야 합니다. Microsoft Graph를 통해 참조하는 자료의 권한과 공유 상태를 점검하고, Purview와 DLP 등 필요한 보호 정책을 적용합니다. 그다음 사용자 교육, 에이전트 승인 절차, 비용과 운영 담당자를 정합니다. 업무 자료를 참조하는 범위는 Copilot 라이선스와 설정에 따라 다릅니다. Copilot 채팅에서 Work IQ를 끄면 Microsoft Graph와 Work IQ를 통한 업무 자료 참조도 꺼집니다. 첨부한 파일이나 앱에서 열어 둔 자료를 사용하는 방식은 별도로 구분해야 합니다. Copilot의 라이선스별 기능과 Work IQ 설정을 확인하세요.

Typical Copilot initiatives include: Microsoft 365 Copilot deployment AI transformation programs Executive productivity improvement Knowledge management modernization Employee experience enhancement Secure AI adoption Copilot governance implementation Global AI rollout

Microsoft 365 Copilot 요소 5개 · 선택하면 역할과 연결을 보여 줍니다 업무 사용자Microsoft Graph접근 권한과 데이터 보호에이전트도입 효과요청권한 범위 안의 자료도구 실행사용 기록업무 사용자Microsoft Graph접근 권한과 데이터 보호에이전트도입 효과요청권한 범위 안의 자료도구 실행사용 기록 업무 사용자 회의 정리, 문서 작성, 메일 처리, 자료 분석 중 어떤 업무에 Copilot을 쓸지 정합니다. Microsoft Graph Exchange, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Planner 등에서 사용자가 접근할 수 있는 업무 자료를 연결합니다. 접근 권한과 데이터 보호 Entra ID와 조건부 액세스, 원본 자료의 권한을 점검합니다. Purview 레이블, DLP와 감사 기록도 함께 검토합니다. 에이전트 Copilot Studio의 에이전트에 업무에 필요한 도구와 워크플로를 연결하고 운영 책임자를 정합니다. 도입 효과 교육과 현업 담당자의 지원이 실제로 도움이 됐는지 사용 기록과 업무 성과를 함께 살펴봅니다.

Decision Recommended Question Pilot scope Which user personas and departments validate Copilot first? Data readiness Which SharePoint and Teams areas need permission cleanup before rollout? Security baseline Are Conditional Access, Purview, DLP and audit controls ready? Agent governance Who can create, approve, publish and retire Copilot Studio agents? Adoption model Which training, champion and office-hour model supports users? Value tracking Which business scenarios prove measurable Copilot value?

Assigning Copilot licenses before permission and data readiness review Treating Copilot as a generic training program instead of role-based adoption Allowing agent creation without approval, lifecycle and ownership rules Measuring only active users without business outcome metrics Ignoring user trust issues caused by overshared or outdated content

Copilot readiness assessment Oversharing and permission review report Copilot governance charter Agent lifecycle and approval model Adoption roadmap and champion plan Use case prioritization matrix Value tracking dashboard

Workstream Focus Executive sponsorship Business priority, communication and funding support Champion network Department use cases, local support and feedback Training Role-based prompt and workflow enablement Office hours Prompt coaching and use case support Governance forum Security, compliance, agent and adoption decisions Analytics Usage, satisfaction, use case value and support trends

Secure before scaling. Clean up permissions before broad license assignment. Establish governance before agent creation. Treat adoption as role-based behavior change. Measure business value, not only usage.

Use this checklist before approving a Microsoft 365, Security, Copilot or Azure program. Question Why It Matters What business outcome is this program expected to improve? Documents the business objective alongside technical delivery Which data and users are in scope? Controls risk and licensing assumptions Who owns policy decisions and exceptions? Records policy owners and exception responsibilities Which security controls must be in place before rollout? Reduces disruption and audit gaps What pilot group validates the design? Records feasibility and unresolved constraints for the tested scope What SOW, WBS and risk register are required? Connects architecture to delivery execution How will success be measured after rollout? Defines measures for usage, cost and business outcomes

For customer workshops, use this sequence: Confirm business drivers and risk concerns. Map Microsoft workloads to the business outcome. Review current tenant, identity, security and data posture. Identify Copilot, migration or Azure readiness gaps. Define target architecture and governance decisions. Convert decisions into proposal scope, SOW, WBS and risk register. Agree on pilot, rollout and operating model.

documents.t: Governance architecture defines how Microsoft 365, Azure, Security and Copilot environments are controlled, operated and continuously improved. A successful governance model clarifies decision ownership, policy standards, operational roles, exception handling, lifecycle management and executive reporting. The objective is to prevent platform sprawl, reduce security risk and keep cloud services aligned with business objectives.
Microsoft 365와 Azure를 운영할 때 필요한 의사결정과 책임을 정리한 문서입니다. 서비스별 담당자, 정책 변경 승인자, 예외 처리 절차와 정기 점검 일정을 정합니다. Teams, SharePoint, Azure 구독과 AI 에이전트에도 같은 기준을 적용하되 제품별 설정은 따로 확인해야 합니다.

Typical governance initiatives include: Microsoft 365 tenant governance Teams lifecycle management SharePoint external sharing control Azure subscription governance Copilot readiness governance Security and compliance policy management Global subsidiary governance standardization License and cost optimization AI Agent lifecycle and approval model

Decision Recommended Question Governance board Who owns cross-platform policy decisions? Policy baseline Which controls are mandatory for all users and workloads? Exception process Who approves exceptions, and when do they expire? Workspace lifecycle How are Teams, sites, groups and agents created and retired? Evidence model What metrics prove governance is operating effectively? Review cadence How often are policies, risks and exceptions reviewed?

Creating policies without accountable owners Allowing permanent security exceptions Treating Teams and SharePoint governance as an admin-only task Measuring governance only by license usage Launching Copilot or AI Agents without data and lifecycle governance

Enterprise governance charter Policy baseline matrix RACI and decision authority model Teams and SharePoint lifecycle policy Azure subscription and tagging standard Copilot and AI Agent governance model Exception register and review cadence Executive governance dashboard

Role Responsibility Executive Sponsor Business priority, funding and escalation Governance Board Cross-domain policy decision and risk acceptance Platform Owner Microsoft 365, Azure or Security service ownership Security Owner Control baseline, incident process and exception approval Compliance Owner Data protection, retention, audit and regulatory alignment Service Desk User support, intake and operational feedback

Governance must be simple enough to operate repeatedly. Policies need owners, evidence and review dates. Exception handling is as important as policy design. Copilot governance depends on existing data and collaboration governance. Executive visibility turns governance from documentation into an operating rhythm.

documents.t: Microsoft 365 should not be deployed as a standalone productivity platform. Enterprise success requires an integrated architecture spanning identity, collaboration, security, compliance, governance and operational management. This reference architecture provides a standardized framework for Microsoft 365 modernization, security transformation, migration and Copilot readiness programs. The objective is to establish a scalable, secure and operationally sustainable digital workplace platform that aligns with business objectives while reducing operational complexity and security risk.

Exchange, Teams, SharePoint와 OneDrive를 도입할 때 Entra ID, Intune, Defender와 Purview를 함께 검토하는 참조 설계입니다. 사용자 권한, 기기 관리, 데이터 보호와 지원 업무를 누가 맡을지 정하고, 이 구성이 실제 업무에서 작동하는지 확인합니다. 업무 자료를 참조하는 범위는 Copilot 라이선스와 설정에 따라 다릅니다. Copilot 채팅에서 Work IQ를 끄면 Microsoft Graph와 Work IQ를 통한 업무 자료 참조도 꺼집니다. 첨부한 파일이나 앱에서 열어 둔 자료를 사용하는 방식은 별도로 구분해야 합니다. Copilot의 라이선스별 기능과 Work IQ 설정을 확인하세요.

Typical enterprise initiatives include: Microsoft 365 tenant modernization Exchange Online migration Teams and SharePoint adoption File server modernization Security and compliance transformation Zero Trust implementation Microsoft 365 Copilot readiness Global governance standardization License optimization initiatives Common stakeholders include: CIO CISO IT Director Infrastructure Manager Security Operations Team Compliance Team Collaboration Platform Owner
The architecture should follow the following principles:
Prioritize Microsoft cloud-native capabilities before introducing third-party solutions.
Identity becomes the primary security control plane.
Never trust. Always verify.
Grant only the minimum level of access required.
Governance must be designed before large-scale rollout.
Security controls should be enabled by design.
Reduce unnecessary complexity.
Architecture must support global subsidiaries and regional requirements.
Reference ArchitectureUser productivity to governed AI readiness

Identity architecture should define: Microsoft Entra ID tenant model Authentication methods MFA enforcement Conditional Access policies Privileged access management Guest access governance Identity lifecycle management Recommended baseline: Area Recommendation MFA 일반 사용자 MFA 적용 및 긴급 계정 별도 보호 Conditional Access Use Entra ID P1 for baseline policies; user-risk and sign-in-risk policies require Entra ID P2 Admin Access Use PIM where available Guest Access Review and govern regularly Legacy Authentication Block by default See Conditional Access license requirements.

Microsoft Teams and SharePoint should be designed as an integrated collaboration platform. Key areas: Teams lifecycle SharePoint site architecture Permission model External sharing Guest access Information architecture Ownership model Recommended governance: Area Recommendation Teams Creation Controlled or governed External Sharing Restricted by sensitivity Site Ownership Minimum two owners Inactive Teams Review periodically Permission Review Establish recurring process

Security controls should include: Microsoft Defender XDR Defender for Endpoint Defender for Office 365 Conditional Access Microsoft Purview DLP Sensitivity Labels Insider Risk Management Recommended architecture: M365 security architectureSignal, protect, respond 01Security signalsIdentity, device, email and cloud app signals flow into Microsoft Defender XDR. 02XDR correlationIncidents are grouped with entities, severity, timeline and response guidance. 03Data protectionUse Microsoft Purview labels and DLP to protect collaboration data, and audit to record supported activities. 04SOC operationSecurity teams act through triage, incident response, evidence and improvement backlog.

Successful Copilot adoption requires: Identity modernization SharePoint permission review Information architecture cleanup Data governance Sensitivity label design DLP policy review User adoption strategy Responsible AI governance Copilot readiness model: Copilot readiness architectureData-safe adoption path 01Identity and securityEntra ID, Conditional Access, Defender, device compliance and privileged access are reviewed first. 02Data governanceSharePoint permissions, Purview labels, DLP and content ownership are cleaned up. 03Pilot readinessUse cases, user groups, risk controls, help desk and adoption messaging are prepared. 04Enterprise rolloutScale with adoption telemetry, policy review, champion feedback and governance cadence.

Operational ownership should be defined across: Area Owner Identity IAM Team Messaging Messaging Team Collaboration M365 Team Security Security Team Compliance Compliance Team Endpoint Endpoint Management Team Governance IT Leadership

Expected business and technical outcomes include: Improved security posture Reduced operational complexity Standardized governance Improved collaboration experience Better data protection Copilot readiness Stronger executive visibility Scalable global operating model

Recommended phased approach: Phase Focus Output Phase 1 Assessment Current state and risk analysis Phase 2 Architecture Target-state design Phase 3 Governance Policy and operating model Phase 4 Security Baseline Identity, endpoint and data protection Phase 5 Adoption User enablement and change management Phase 6 Optimization Continuous improvement

Decision Recommended Question Tenant model Is the tenant designed for global, subsidiary or M&A requirements? Identity baseline Are MFA, Conditional Access, guest access and PIM standards defined? Collaboration model How are Teams, SharePoint sites, groups and external sharing governed? Security baseline Which Defender, Intune and Purview controls are mandatory before rollout? Copilot readiness Which SharePoint permissions, labels and DLP controls must be remediated first? Operating model Who owns lifecycle, policy, incidents, support and continuous improvement?

Deploying Microsoft 365 as only email and collaboration tools Enabling Teams or SharePoint broadly without lifecycle ownership Treating external sharing as a one-time setting instead of a governance process Assigning Copilot licenses before permission and data readiness review Operating Defender and Purview as separate tools without integrated reporting Measuring platform success only by active users or license assignment

documents.t: Microsoft 365 migration architecture should be designed as a business transition program, not only as a technical data transfer project. A successful migration aligns identity, mail flow, collaboration, permissions, security, user communication, service desk readiness and operational support. This architecture provides a standardized framework for tenant-to-tenant migration, Google Workspace migration, Exchange migration and file server to Microsoft 365 migration projects.
이전 작업을 시작하기 전에 원본 환경과 대상 테넌트의 차이를 확인해야 합니다. 계정 연결, 메일 흐름, 파일 권한, 보안 정책과 사용자 안내를 준비하고, 시험 이전부터 전환·복구·안정화까지 단계별 담당자와 완료 조건을 정합니다.

Typical migration scenarios include: Exchange Server to Exchange Online Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 Tenant-to-Tenant migration File Server or NAS to SharePoint Online OneDrive migration Teams migration Global subsidiary consolidation M&A integration or divestiture
Migration Architecture OverviewSource environment to stabilized Microsoft 365 operations

Domain Design Focus Key Output Identity User mapping, domain strategy, authentication Identity mapping workbook Messaging Mailbox, shared mailbox, mail flow, coexistence Mail migration plan Collaboration Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, permissions Collaboration mapping plan Security Conditional Access, Defender, Purview, DLP Security baseline Communication User readiness, cutover notice, support process Communication plan Operations Service desk, hypercare, rollback criteria Stabilization model

Decision Recommended Question Migration scope Which workloads and user groups are included in each wave? Cutover strategy Is the project big-bang, phased, coexistence or hybrid? Identity mapping How are users, domains, aliases and guests mapped? Permission handling Which permissions are migrated, redesigned or removed? Security baseline Which controls must be active before user cutover? Hypercare Who supports users during the first business days after cutover?

Starting migration before source inventory and ownership are validated Treating permission migration as a copy-only activity Running cutover without business communication and service desk readiness Ignoring coexistence, DNS and mail flow dependencies Measuring success only by migrated item count

Migration assessment report Source-to-target mapping workbook Migration wave plan Cutover runbook Communication template set Risk and issue register Hypercare and stabilization plan Executive migration status report

Industry Scenario Success Pattern Manufacturing Global mail and file migration Wave-based migration with local champions and weekend cutover control Retail Google Workspace to Microsoft 365 Department mapping, training and staged SharePoint adoption Financial Services Tenant consolidation Security baseline validation before production cutover Technology M&A tenant integration Identity mapping, coexistence and executive reporting cadence

Migration quality depends on assessment quality. Permission cleanup improves both security and Copilot readiness. Explain the cutover impact, known risks and support path before each wave. Hypercare must be planned before cutover, not after user issues start. Executive reporting should show risk, readiness and business impact, not only item counts.

궁금한 영역을 선택하면 해당 설계 문서의 구성도로 이동합니다. 이 지도는 주제를 분류하고, 각 문서의 구성도는 실제 연결을 보여 줍니다.
Microsoft 365, Azure, 보안과 Copilot의 설계 문서를 모았습니다. 도입 목적에 맞는 구성을 정하고 관련 제품의 적용 조건을 확인할 때 참고하세요. 구성도와 함께 설계 이유, 결정할 사항, 운영 담당자와 인수할 자료를 정리하면 고객과 작업 범위를 합의하기 쉽습니다.

영역 설계할 때 답해야 할 질문 Microsoft 365 테넌트, 협업, ID, 거버넌스를 어떻게 설계할 것인가? 보안 ID, 기기, 데이터, 메일, 네트워크 통제가 어떻게 함께 작동하는가? Copilot 어떤 준비도, 데이터 보호, 도입 구조가 필요한가? Azure 어떤 랜딩 존, 네트워크, ID, 업무 시스템 패턴이 필요한가? 마이그레이션 어떤 목표 상태와 전환 구조로 이전을 이끌 것인가? 거버넌스 어떤 결정, 정책, 책임자, 운영 주기가 필요한가?
현재 상태와 목표 상태 아키텍처 업무 시스템 의존 관계도 ID와 접근 권한 모델 보안 기준과 통제 매트릭스 거버넌스와 운영 모델 전환 아키텍처 경영진용 아키텍처 요약

검토 관점 핵심 질문 확인할 근거 사업 적합성 이 아키텍처가 어떤 업무 문제를 푸는가? 경영진 요약, 이해관계자 요구사항 지도 ID 사용자, 관리자, 게스트, 업무 시스템을 어떻게 인증하고 권한을 주는가? Entra ID 설계, 역할 모델, 접근 정책 보안 어떤 통제가 위험을 막고, 탐지하고, 대응하는가? 조건부 액세스, Defender, Purview, 로그 모델 데이터 민감한 정보를 어떻게 분류, 공유, 보존, 보호하는가? DLP, 보존, 민감도 레이블, 공유 설계 운영 사고, 변경, 예외, 지속 개선은 누가 맡는가? 운영 모델, RACI, 인수인계 점검표 도입 사용자, 챔피언, 서비스 책임자가 플랫폼을 올바르게 쓰게 하는 방법은? 도입 계획, 교육 자료, 성과 지표
Microsoft 서비스를 고르기 전에 사업 목표를 확인합니다. 반드시 필요한 통제와 선택적 개선을 나눕니다. 전제, 제약, 제외 범위를 문서로 남깁니다. 설계 결정마다 구축 작업과 책임자 이름을 붙입니다. 거버넌스와 인수인계는 프로젝트 마지막이 아니라 처음부터 포함합니다.

documents.s: Make security controls measurable, operable and evidence-backed

documents.t: Enterprise security architecture should be designed using a Zero Trust model. The objective is to continuously verify users, devices, applications and data access while reducing cyber risk and enabling secure productivity. Microsoft security architecture integrates identity, endpoint, email, collaboration, cloud applications, data protection and security operations into a unified operating model.
Microsoft 제품으로 Zero Trust 보안을 구성할 때 참고할 수 있는 설계입니다. Entra ID와 Conditional Access로 접근을 제어하고, Intune과 Defender로 기기 상태를 확인하며, Purview로 데이터를 보호합니다. 제품별 담당자와 사고 대응 절차도 함께 정합니다.

Typical security initiatives include: Zero Trust transformation Conditional Access implementation Microsoft Defender XDR deployment Endpoint security modernization Email threat protection Microsoft Purview implementation DLP and information protection Security operations improvement Copilot security readiness

ID와 접근 권한 Entra ID와 조건부 액세스에서 로그인 조건을 평가하고, PIM에서 관리자 역할의 활성화를 관리합니다. 기기와 협업 환경 기기 상태와 위협 신호를 반영해 접근 및 데이터 정책을 정한 뒤 각 서비스에서 적용 결과를 확인합니다. 데이터 보호와 대응 Purview의 레이블과 DLP로 자료를 보호하고, Defender XDR과 Sentinel에서 인시던트를 조사하고 대응합니다. 거버넌스 정책과 예외의 책임자를 정하고, 정기 검토 때 살펴볼 기록과 개선 과제를 남깁니다.
